component.name: Eve-Strait
component.summary: Plan capital and jump freighter routes in EVE Online

description.p: A route planner for EVE Online capitals and jump freighters. It draws a pannable, zoomable map of New Eden, shows your jump range, and plans routes across stargates, jump drives, Ansiblex jump gates and scouted wormholes, computing fuel and jump-fatigue timing for every leg.

Routes are explained rather than merely produced: every leg says how it is travelled, what it costs, and — for a wormhole — which signature to warp to and how long ago anyone last confirmed it was there.
Signing in to EVE is optional. The map, ranges, fuel and routing all work without it; signing in adds the stations and structures your own characters can dock at.
